interfaceCtat.descricao: Interface FIXA do tutor (a mesma tela para todos os problemas): enunciado; pergunta "What is the fraction in the problem?" com duas caixas numéricas (f1 em cima = numerador, f2 embaixo = denominador); reta numérica de 0 a 2 (numline) onde o aluno marca um ponto, com encaixe em 12 partes por unidade (marcas ocultas), pontos rotulados; botão Hint; botão Done. Os passos do aluno são ações NESSES componentes (digitar nos campos, converter, marcar o ponto, concluir).

dicas.texto: Decide whether Jamie filled less than one tray, exactly one tray, or more than one tray.
Put the completely filled tray in the whole-number field and represent the second tray as a fraction.
The second tray has 12 spaces in all, and 11 of those spaces are filled.
Enter 1 as the whole number, 11 as the fractional numerator, and 12 as the fractional denominator.
An improper fraction must include the complete tray as well as the filled spaces in the second tray.
Multiply the whole-number part by the denominator, add the fractional numerator, and keep the denominator.
First calculate 1 × 12, then add 11 to that result while keeping 12 below the fraction bar.
Use the total number of twelfths from the complete tray and the second tray, then write that total over 12.
The numerator tells how many equal parts are represented altogether.
Use the number of twelfths in one complete tray and add the eleven twelfths from the second tray.
One complete tray contributes 12 twelfths, and the second tray contributes 11 twelfths.
Add 12 and 11, then enter that total in the upper fraction field.
Locate the point by comparing the fraction with the whole numbers 1 and 2.
Rewrite the improper fraction as one whole unit plus a fractional part, then move that part beyond 1.
The point is between 1 and 2 and is one small interval before 2.
Start at 1 and count eleven of the twelve equal intervals toward 2, then place the point there.
The denominator tells how many equal spaces make one complete muffin tray.
Look at the total number of spaces in one tray and use that number below the fraction bar.
Each muffin tray is divided into ... equal spaces.
Enter the number of spaces in one complete tray in the lower fraction field.

exercicio.statement:
Jamie is helping her parents bake a very large batch of muffins for a party tomorrow. Jamie's task is to fill the muffin tray with the muffin batter. Each muffin tray makes 12 muffins. Jamie filled one muffin tray completely, but could only fill 11 spaces of the second tray. This means she filled 1 and 11/12 muffin trays. Show this fraction on the number line.
What is the fraction in the problem?

Use the number of twelfths in one complete tray and add the eleven twelfths from the second tray.
One complete tray contributes 12 twelfths, and the second tray contributes 11 twelfths.
Add 12 and 11, then enter that total in the upper fraction field.

nodes.description: Mark 23/12 on the number line from 0 to 2.
nodes.instruction: Mark 23/12 on the number line from 0 to 2.

hints.message: Locate the point by comparing the fraction with the whole numbers 1 and 2.
Rewrite the improper fraction as one whole unit plus a fractional part, then move that part beyond 1.
The point is between 1 and 2 and is one small interval before 2.
Start at 1 and count eleven of the twelve equal intervals toward 2, then place the point there.

misconceptions.description: O aluno tem dificuldade em posicionar frações maiores que 1 e aninha no inteiro.
misconceptions.feedback: You marked the whole number 1, but Jamie filled more than one tray. The point must be slightly to the right of 1.

misconceptions.description: Erro de contagem de marcas (contar marcas em vez de espaços).
misconceptions.feedback: You stopped one interval too early. From 1, count eleven equal intervals toward 2, not only ten.

nodes.description: Enter the denominator of the final fraction.
nodes.instruction: Enter the denominator of the final fraction.

hints.message: The denominator tells how many equal spaces make one complete muffin tray.
Look at the total number of spaces in one tray and use that number below the fraction bar.
Each muffin tray is divided into ... equal spaces.
Enter the number of spaces in one complete tray in the lower fraction field.

nodes.description: O aluno ignora o número inteiro ao converter para fração imprópria.
nodes.instruction: You left out the complete tray. One whole tray equals twelve twelfths, so it must be included in the conversion.

nodes.description: O aluno tenta somar todos os valores numéricos disponíveis no enunciado.
nodes.instruction: You added the denominator to the numerator calculation. The denominator 12 describes the size of each group; use 1 × 12 + 11 for the new numerator.

nodes.description: O aluno inverte a fração da parte fracionária.
nodes.instruction: You reversed the fractional parts. The 11 filled spaces are the numerator, while the 12 total spaces are the denominator.
